person_note: Multiple Goodreads event passages independently show an external narrator presenting Mace, Beth, Hope, Reiger, and other characters in sustained third-person scenes. Dialogue and aphorisms containing I, we, or you are local material, while the incomplete fragments are not reliable evidence. The authorized five-chapter opening likewise maintains third-person narration across several focal characters, with no sign of a participating narrator or sustained person alternation. The label is medium confidence because the only strong web prose source is confined to the opening and no credible whole-book structural description was located. Audit: independent review confirmed that the authorized excerpt covers only Chapters 1–5 while the Goodreads sample supplies separate interior third-person scenes; THIRD/med is retained without treating plot-summary grammar as POV evidence.
